description.value: DD Mau Chinatown is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant in Vancouver's historic Chinatown, opened in 2018 as a sister location to the original 2012 Yaletown spot. The menu draws on the owners' Vietnamese heritage — rooted in Tra Vinh Province — spanning classics like bánh mì and salad rolls to modern interpretations of Vietnamese cuisine. The restaurant also runs a recurring 'Feast & Friends' collaborative dinner series featuring guest chefs from Vancouver's hospitality community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website actively confirms the address (145 East Pender St, Vancouver BC), phone ((604) 559 6076), and that the business is open, with an upcoming events series, so all OSM contact fields are corroborated. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the website's 'PICKUP / DOORDASH / UBEREATS' section; vegetarian options are evidenced by the catering menu listing Lemongrass Tofu banh mi and Tofu salad rolls. No mention of bike parking, racks, Wi-Fi, charging, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Th) conflicts with current website hours listing, which states the restaurant is closed on Sundays and Mondays — OSM tag may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible Vietnamese restaurant with a confirmed website and matching contact details; suitable stop for touring cyclists in Vancouver's Chinatown.
